stemMd: A report says that the number of people using the city pool fell after fees rose. It concludes that every former user stopped attending because of the fee. What is the strongest criticism?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The report proves that fees never affect attendance.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The report cannot compare different years.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The report assumes the pool is privately owned.

options.label: D
options.textMd: An aggregate decline does not establish each individual's reason for stopping.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The report says all current users are wealthy.

explanationMd: Even if higher fees contributed to the total decline, some former users may have moved, become ill, or changed schedules. A population-level change cannot support a universal claim about individual motives.

distractorRationale.a: The criticism need not deny a price effect.
distractorRationale.b: Yearly comparisons can be informative with appropriate controls.
